freeze.amendment_policy: Never edit this file. Keep v1-v7. A later change needs v9 with every delta explained.

deltas_from_v7: Neutrino ledger: Planck omega_c = 0.1200 counts cold dark matter only, so every early-universe row (theta*, omega_c, r_d, sigma8) now uses omega_c = Omega_DM h^2 - omega_nu with the CE neutrino sum P17 (59.16 meV). Late-time Omega_m unchanged. No new continuous parameter.
Found after inspecting the CMB-BAO tension; adopted because the Planck definition forces it, including rows that get worse (omega_c -0.73 -> -1.26 sigma; variant IV 0.834 -> 0.849).
CMB-BAO scale tension +3.07 -> +2.65 sigma; DES Y3 S8 +2.59 -> +2.42 sigma.
